#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll mod = 998244353;

ll powerMod(ll b, ll e, ll m) {
    ll x = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1)
            x = (b * x) % m;
        b = (b * b) % m;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return x;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    cout.tie(NULL);

    ll n, m;
    int L, R;
    cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;

    ll diff = R - L + 1;
    ll p1 = diff / 2;
    ll p2 = diff - p1;
    ll nm = n * m;
    ll ans;

    if (nm % 2 == 1) {
        ans = powerMod(diff, nm, mod);
    } else {
        ll pp1 = diff;
        ll pp2 = abs(p1 - p2);
        ll opt1 = powerMod(pp1, nm, mod);
        ll opt2 = powerMod(pp2, nm, mod);
        ll inv2 = powerMod(2, mod - 2, mod);
        ll opt = (opt1 + opt2) % mod;
        opt = (opt * inv2) % mod;
        ans = opt;
    }

    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
